contracts.bounds: each value is non-empty, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, and contains no control character

context_policies.rule: Opaque snapshots, commands, and authorization-state values are valid only inside their creating query-only transaction; rollback ends the epoch, retry creates a new identifier and complete reread, and identifier exhaustion denies without reuse.
Normal service open neither creates nor migrates a database; schema creation and v1-to-v2 upgrade occur only through the explicit migration operation.
ALLOW is possible only after every identity, cardinality, field, revision, currentness, scope, and permission predicate passes.

implementation_ready: single query-only transaction across all reads and evaluation followed by rollback
opaque lifetime-bound epoch values with checked non-reusing identifiers
unified schema v2 with explicit idempotent migration and newer-version rejection
bounded inbound identifiers and cardinality-limited singleton queries
private typed diagnostics with binary-only public output
reserved_for_product_test: normal startup cannot create or migrate schema
concurrent-writer snapshot consistency and fresh-retry behavior
deterministic DomainSpec runtime replay and whole-service validation

claim_limit: Prototype contracts aligned to a locally executed implementation candidate. Local tests and deterministic checks do not approve the product or grant admission, activation, publication, release, deployment, or any external authority.
